# Genetic Ancestry & Self-Reported Race

## Ancestry Classification and PCA (bigsnpr)

<!--- Reference Samples ---------->
```{r}
## Download 1000G Reference Data
pc_dat_path <- c("CHAPTER1/DC_Project2_YoungV5/PC_Data/")
ref_1000G_fams <- read.table(paste0(pc_dat_path, "1000G_phase3_common_norel.fam"))
ref_1000G_pops <- read.table(paste0(pc_dat_path, "1000G_phase3_common_norel.fam2"), header = T, sep = "\t")
```

<!--- Setup Files and Project --->
```{r}
obj.bed_ref <- bed(paste0(pc_dat_path, "1000G_phase3_common_norel.bed"))
obj.bed_fhs <- bed(paste0(pc_dat_path, "affy37_qc3.bed"))

## Exclude Ambiguous SNPs
ref.to.fhs_project <- bed_projectPCA(obj.bed_ref, obj.bed_fhs, k = 20, ncores = 6)
```

<!--- Extract Reference/Target PCs and SuperPopulation Labels -->
```{r}
## Three components of ref.to.fhs_project output:
## PCs of reference sample (1000G); predict() required
ref_pcs <- predict(ref.to.fhs_project$obj.svd.ref) %>% as.data.frame() %>% bind_cols(ref_1000G_pops)
## PCs of target (FHS) sample using simple projection
## fhs_fullsamp_pcs1 <- ref.to.fhs_project$simple_proj %>% as.data.frame()
## PCs of target (FHS) sample using OADP projection
fhs_fullsamp_pcs2 <- ref.to.fhs_project$OADP_proj %>% as.data.frame() 
```

<!--- Perform KNN Test to Determine SuperPopulation of FHS Sample --->
```{r}
## OADP Projection
knn_1000G.p2 <- knn(train = ref_pcs[,1:20], test = fhs_fullsamp_pcs2[,1:20], cl = ref_pcs$SuperPopulation, prob = T, k = 20, l = 20)
summary(knn_1000G.p2)

## PCs for FHS sample only with added SuperPop classifier
fhs_fullsamp_pcs3 <- bind_cols(fhs_fullsamp_pcs2, "SuperPopulation" = knn_1000G.p2) %>% rename_with(~paste0("PC", 1:20), paste0("V", 1:20))
## Combine with pedigree info
fhs_qc3_fam <- read.table(paste0(pc_dat_path, "affy37_qc3.fam")) %>% 
  select("SHAREID" = V2, "PEDNO" = V1, "FSHARE" = V3, "MSHARE" = V4, "SEX" = 5)

fhs_pcs3_plus_ped <- fhs_qc3_fam %>% bind_cols(fhs_fullsamp_pcs3) %>% relocate(SuperPopulation, .after = SEX) %>%
  ## 35 NAs means classified as ambiguous by PCA analysis - Recode to make clear ancestry still tested
  mutate(SuperPopulation = case_match(SuperPopulation, NA ~ "AMBIG", .default = SuperPopulation))

## Combine Reference (1000G) PCs/Known SuperPop labels with FHS PCs/Predicted SuperPop Labels
fhs_plus_ref_pcs <- ref_pcs %>% rename_with(~paste0("PC", 1:20), paste0("V", 1:20)) %>%
  relocate(REFID = sample.ID, SEX = sex, Population, SuperPopulation) %>% select(-PopulationDescription) %>%
  bind_rows(fhs_pcs3_plus_ped) %>%
  relocate(SHAREID, PEDNO, FSHARE, MSHARE, .after = REFID)
```

```{r}
write.table(fhs_plus_ref_pcs, file = "AYoung_Gen3_FinalV2/FHS_NewPC_Dat/fhs_plus_ref_pcs.txt", row.names = F, quote = F)
```

```{r}
race_check_g3 <- read.csv("AYoung_Gen3_FinalV2/FHS_NewPheno_Dat/g3_fin.rc_phenos.csv") %>%
  select(SHAREID, IDTYPE, RACE.vec_E1, RACE.vec_E2)
race_check_g2n <- read.csv("AYoung_Gen3_FinalV2/FHS_NewPheno_Dat/g2n_fin.rc_phenos.csv") %>%
  select(SHAREID, IDTYPE, RACE.vec_E1, RACE.vec_E2)
race_check_g2 <- read.csv("AYoung_Gen3_FinalV2/FHS_NewPheno_Dat/g2_fin.rc_phenos.csv") %>%
  select(SHAREID, IDTYPE, RACE.vec_E8)

race_check_all <- race_check_g3 %>%
  bind_rows(race_check_g2n) %>%
  bind_rows(race_check_g2) %>% 
  mutate(RACE.vec_E2 = case_when(RACE.vec_E2 == RACE.vec_E1 ~ NA, .default = RACE.vec_E2)) %>%
  unite("RACE_COMBO", contains("RACE"), na.rm = T) %>% mutate(RACE_COMBO = na_if(RACE_COMBO, "")) %>%
  left_join(fhs_plus_ref_pcs %>% select(SHAREID, PEDNO, FSHARE, MSHARE, "SUPOP" = SuperPopulation), by = "SHAREID")

race_check_fam <- race_check_all %>%
  left_join(race_check_all %>% select("P.SHAREID" = SHAREID, "P.SUPOP" = SUPOP, "P.RACE_COMBO" = RACE_COMBO), by = c("FSHARE" = "P.SHAREID")) %>%
  left_join(race_check_all %>% select("M.SHAREID" = SHAREID, "M.SUPOP" = SUPOP, "M.RACE_COMBO" = RACE_COMBO), by = c("MSHARE" = "M.SHAREID")) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  ## 144 with own or parents' race something other than white exclusively
  mutate(RACE_FLAG = sum(!((RACE_COMBO %in% c("WHITE", NA)) & (P.RACE_COMBO %in% c("WHITE", NA)) & (M.RACE_COMBO %in% c("WHITE", NA)))),
         POP_FLAG = sum(!((SUPOP %in% c("EUR", NA)) & (P.SUPOP %in% c("EUR", NA)) & (M.SUPOP %in% c("EUR", NA))))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(SUPOP)) %>%
  filter(RACE_FLAG == 1) %>% filter(SUPOP == "EUR") %>% filter(!(RACE_COMBO == "WHITE")) %>%
  filter(!(is.na(P.RACE_COMBO) & is.na(M.RACE_COMBO))) %>%
  filter(!((P.RACE_COMBO %in% c("WHITE", NA)) & (M.RACE_COMBO %in% c("WHITE", NA)))) 

print(race_check_fam %>% select(SHAREID, PEDNO, FSHARE, MSHARE))

  filter(SUPOP == "EUR") %>%
  filter(!(is.na(P.SUPOP) & is.na(P.RACE_COMBO) & is.na(M.SUPOP) & is.na(M.RACE_COMBO))) %>%
  filter(!(is.na(P.SUPOP) | is.na(M.SUPOP))) %>%
  ## Remove 5 respondents whose parent reports of hispanic ancestry match those of offspring
  filter(!(RACE_COMBO == "WHITE"))
```

## Genetic PCs for Subsequent Analysis

<!--- Use EURO filtered sample (above) -->
```{bash}
./plink2 --bfile PC_Data/affy37_qc3 --keep PC_Data/fhs_euro_samp_list.txt --make-bed --out PC_Data/affy37_qc4
```

```{r}
## Apply to FHS Data
fhs_bedfile <- "PC_Data/affy37_qc4.bed"
fhs_fam <- read.table("PC_Data/affy37_qc4.fam")

## 731 respondents with no relationship ties (beyond set kinship threshold)
## Use to project remaining sample
obj.fhsbed <- bed(fhs_bedfile)
fhs_rel_pairs <- snp_plinkKINGQC("./plink2", fhs_bedfile, make.bed = FALSE, ncores = 6)
fhs_nonrel <- fhs_fam %>% filter(!(V2 %in% fhs_rel_pairs$IID1 | V2 %in% fhs_rel_pairs$IID2))
## Create index for non-relative reference
ind.norel <- match(fhs_nonrel[,"V2"], obj.fhsbed$fam$sample.ID)
obj.svd <- bed_autoSVD(obj.fhsbed, ind.row = ind.norel, k = 20, ncores = 6)
proj <- bed_projectSelfPCA(obj.svd, obj.fhsbed, ind.row = rows_along(obj.fhsbed)[-ind.norel], ncores = 6)

## Can't just bind rows from reference/projected set in proj, since need to align with original
## indices in order to map to sample.ID
PCs <- matrix(NA, nrow(obj.fhsbed), ncol(obj.svd$u))
PCs[ind.norel, ] <- predict(proj[["obj.svd.ref"]])
PCs[-ind.norel, ] <- proj$OADP_proj
dimnames(PCs)[[2]] <- paste('PC', 1:20, sep='')
PCs <- PCs %>% as.data.frame() %>% mutate(SHAREID = obj.fhsbed$fam$sample.ID) %>% relocate(SHAREID)

write.table(PCs, "PC_Data/FHS_PCs.txt", quote = F, row.names = F)
```

```{bash Remove Non-White Sample}
## 68 removed
~/plink1.9/plink \
  --bfile Affy550K_QC_Sets/Affy550K_qc4 \
  --remove race_drop_list.txt \

## Check updated pedigree

~/New_Programs/king -b \
    Affy550K_QC_Sets/Affy550K_qc5.bed \

    --prefix KING_Output/Affy550K_qc5
```
